To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1,4-DHP derivatives are synthesized and the compounds were found to have a high antiradical potential.
1,4-DHP compounds are synthesized, and the compounds with the highest antioxidant activity are those with two hydroxyl substituents in the 4-substituent.
a series of novel derivatives of 1,4-DHP was synthesized by alkylation of the thione group of 3-cyanomethylthiopyridines with methyl iodide in presence of piperidin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of novel 1,4-di-hydropyridines and the investigation of their antiradical properties.
the synthesis of novel compounds containing the 1,4- dihydropyridine fragment in the molecule and with the evaluation of their antioxidant activity.
the synthesis of 1,4- dihydropyridine derivatives containing various substituents in their molecule and their antiradical properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
5-acetyl derivatives of 1,4-di-hydropyridines are more active antioxidants than 5-hydroxy derivatives.
the 4-aryl substituents in the dihydropyridine nucleus are the most important structural feature for antiradical action.

the introduction of an alkylthio group into the 2 position of the dihydropyridine system and the introduction of an acetyl group in the 5 position of the diene system are favorable for increasing the antioxidant activity of the synthesized compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the introduction of an alkylthio group into the molecule of 1,4-DHP derivatives is accompanied by a decrease in the antioxidant activity, but the presence in the molecule of 4-hydroxyl and/or 3,5-ditert-butyl-4-hydroxy groups in the phenyl substituent leads to an increase in the antiradical properties of these compounds.
the 5-acetyl derivatives of 1,4-di­hydropyridine are characterized by a high antiradical potential and can be used as effective antioxidants in the synthesis of new polymeric materials.
the presence of a hydroxyl group in the aromatic ring increases the antiradical effect of 1,4- dihydropyridine derivatives.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of a hydroxyl group in the 4-substituted phenyl ring of the synthesized compounds leads to a considerable enhancement of the antiradical properties of the 1,4-di­hydropyridine derivatives.
the 4-aryl substituent of the 1,4- dihydropyridine nucleus plays an important role in the antiradical properties of the synthesized compounds.
the introduction of an alkoxy group at the 4-position of a 4-aryl group of a 1,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine derivative leads to an increase in the antiradical properties of the compound.
